svg.title: Pulse: a RISC-V SoC with an INT8 systolic-array NPU
svg.desc: A 5-stage pipelined RV32IM CPU driving an 8 by 8 INT8 systolic-array NPU, verified against a C++ reference simulator and closed at 40 MHz on a Lattice ECP5 FPGA. MNIST runs 115 times faster on the NPU than on the CPU alone; the NPU sustains 58.9 of 64 MACs per cycle; the CPU scores 2.86 CoreMark/MHz. Diagram: the CPU, instruction memory, the NPU and banked data memory shared through a 32-bit CPU port and a 16-byte-per-cycle DMA port.
